scene_sentences: Prepare ingredients for California Coleslaw: cabbage, onion, bell pepper, carrot, cider vinegar, white sugar, salt, freshly black pepper, vegetable oil.

Step 1 of California Coleslaw: In a large salad bowl, place the cabbage, onion, green bell pepper, red bell pepper and carrot. Combine the vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper and vegetable oil in the bowl with the vegetables. Toss the mixture until the vegetables are fully coated with the marinade..
